routine.title: Library after-school reading club
routine.stage_fit_rationale: School-age children can follow a weekly structured club and this taps directly into a stated interest in books, building on their growing independent-reading stamina.

routine.title: Community soccer or sports league
routine.stage_fit_rationale: A low-pressure recreational league suits a school-age child's developing coordination and teamwork skills, and matches their soccer interest without over-committing.

routine.title: Neighbourhood park and playground
routine.stage_fit_rationale: Unstructured weekend playground time gives a school-age child free gross-motor play and downtime to balance the two structured weekday commitments.

parsed.rationale: The week pairs the child's two interests (books, soccer) with one structured weekday activity each, spaced apart, plus a flexible weekend outdoor slot to keep the pace light.
parsed.notes: Left out the Teen volunteer or maker program since its stage_fit is teenager, not child — not age-appropriate yet for this stage.
